device.description: 12-bit octal buffered voltage-output DAC with SPI write-only interface, LDAC and CLR
device.note: dac43508.pdf (SLASF08A) p.3 pinout (Table 4-1), p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 SPI and logic timing (Figure 5-1), p.19 DAC update, LDAC and CLR, p.20 power-on reset and software reset, p.21 SPI (Table 6-1, 24-bit write cycle), p.22-24 register map (Table 7-1)

registers.name: DEVICE_CONFIG
registers.note: write-only; PDNx = 1 powers channel x down (10 kOhm to AGND), all channels start powered down

registers.name: BRDCAST
registers.note: MSB-aligned 12-bit code in bits 11-0; a write loads every channel

registers.name: DACA_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 08h), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACB_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 09h), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACC_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Ah), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACD_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Bh), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACE_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Ch), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACF_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Dh), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACG_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Eh), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACH_DATA
registers.note: DAC buffer register (address 0Fh), MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 of the data word

registers.name: DACA_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTA); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACB_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTB); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACC_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTC); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACD_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTD); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACE_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTE); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACF_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTF); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACG_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTG); zero code at power-on

registers.name: DACH_ACTIVE
registers.note: DAC active register (drives VOUTH); zero code at power-on

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the LDAC pin level (pins.levels); low before a write = asynchronous (immediate) update

commands.name: STATUS_TRIGGER software reset
commands.note: SW_RST = 1010b resets the device to default values (p.20, p.23)

commands.name: BRDCAST write (LDAC low: immediate)
commands.note: address 03h (b = 1; 02h is matched by STATUS_TRIGGER above)

commands.name: BRDCAST write (LDAC high: wait for LDAC)
DACn_DATA write (LDAC low: immediate)
commands.note: addresses 08h-0Fh = channels A-H; asynchronous mode updates at the 24th clock

commands.name: DACn_DATA write (LDAC high: wait for LDAC)

pages: p.3 (pinout), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (SPI/logic timing), p.19-20 (update, LDAC, CLR, reset), p.21 (SPI frame), p.22-24 (registers)
notModeled: analog outputs, external reference and power-down output loads (DEVICE_CONFIG stored only; VOUTx are never driven)
the interface is write-only (p.21): no register can be read back
only the first 24 bits of a longer frame are used: the model also uses the first 24 (fixed frame), but it updates at the 24th clock rather than the 24th rising edge
CLR also zeroes the DAC buffer registers (p.19); the model's clear pin sets the active registers to zero code
5 ms power-on delay before communication is valid
SCLK idle level: Figure 5-1 shows data sampled on SCLK falling edges with SCLK low before the first rising edge (mode 1); a mode 2 host also works on the real part
variants: DAC43508 (8-bit), DAC53508 (10-bit) and DAC63508 (12-bit) share dac43508.pdf; same pinout and registers, the data field is MSB-aligned in bits 11-0 with 4/2/0 don't-care LSBs. Siblings: DAC43508, DAC53508 (own specs).
